mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_documents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND enabled=1AND id<#{cursor} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM document_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM document_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT version_id FROM knowledge_active_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_documents SET version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_documents SET enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_documents SET deleted=1,enabled=0,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE document_versions SET job_id=#{jobId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND job_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.customer_id=#{customerId} AND m.author_role='ai' AND JSON_CONTAINS(m.citations,JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT('document_id',#{documentId},'version_id',#{versionId})))=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version_id=#{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,document_id,version_id,execution_version,ordinal,page,text FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version_id=#{versionId} AND execution_version=#{executionVersion} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE document_versions SET status=#{state},error_code=#{code} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE document_versions SET status='ready',error_code=NULL,embedding_model=#{model},embedding_dimensions=#{dimensions},index_execution_version=#{executionVersion} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_active_versions(tenant_id,document_id,version_id) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{documentId},#{versionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version_id=#{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT g.tenant_id,g.version_id,g.execution_version,g.job_id FROM knowledge_index_generations g JOIN jobs j ON j.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND j.id=g.job_id WHERE g.last_cleanup_at<UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 1 MINUTE AND (g.execution_version<j.execution_version OR j.state IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_versions v JOIN knowledge_active_versions a ON a.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND a.version_id=v.id WHERE v.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND v.id=g.version_id AND v.index_execution_version=g.execution_version) ORDER BY g.last_cleanup_at,g.tenant_id,g.version_id,g.execution_version LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version_id=#{versionId} AND execution_version=#{executionVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_generations SET last_cleanup_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version_id=#{versionId} AND execution_version=#{executionVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT state,error_code FROM jobs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{jobId}
mapper.sql: FROM knowledge_chunks c JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.document_id JOIN knowledge_active_versions a ON a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.document_id=c.document_id AND a.version_id=c.version_id JOIN document_versions v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.id=c.version_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.enabled=1 AND d.deleted=0 AND v.status='ready' AND c.execution_version=v.index_execution_version
mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS version_id,v.index_execution_version AS execution_version,v.embedding_model AS model,v.embedding_dimensions AS dimensions FROM knowledge_active_versions a JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.id=a.document_id JOIN document_versions v ON v.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND v.id=a.version_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.enabled=1 AND d.deleted=0 AND v.status='ready' AND v.index_execution_version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.id
SELECT c.id AND MATCH(c.text) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)>0 ORDER BY MATCH(c.text) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC,c.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT c.document_id,c.version_id,c.id AS chunk_id,v.filename,c.page,c.text,c.execution_version,d.title AND c.id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM document_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.author_role='ai' AND JSON_CONTAINS(m.citations,JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT('version_id',#{versionId})))=1
